list.item: The QR Method for Finding Eigenvalues: This project shows how the QR factorization of a matrix may be used to calculate the eigenvalues of the matrix.

Finding the Roots of a Polynomial with Eigenvalues: This project shows how the real roots of a polynomial can be calculated by finding the eigenvalues of a particular matrix. These eigenvalues will be found by the QR method.
